Kishan Kachhadiya  
+91-9328308575   |  kishankachhadiya823@gmail.com   |  GitHub  |  linkedin.com/in/ kishan -kachhadiya / 
 
SUMMARY  
AI/ML Engineer with expertise in machine learning, deep learning, NLP , speech processing, and MLOps , skilled in LLM fine -
tuning, Retrieval -Augmented Generation (RAG), and FastAPI -based deployment . Proven track record in building scalable 
multilingual AI systems, including legal bots, mathematical retrieval systems, and multimodal story -to-image generation 
pipelines . Achieved 1st Rank at FIRE 2025 (CLMIR & Story -to-Image tracks)  and 3rd place at S4P 2025 Deepfake Audio 
Detection Challenge , demonstrating strong problem -solving, research, and applied AI skills. Proficient in Python, PyTorch, 
Hugging Face, LangChain, MLflow, Docker, with certifications in Azure Fundamentals  and SAP Analytics Cloud . 
EXPERIENCE  
IRLP Lab, DAIICT            Gandhinagar , India  
Jr. Computer Scientist                         Nov, 2024  – Present  
• Trained the NLLB 3.3B model  on 22 Indian language government and health datasets , advancing multilingual NLP 
research and improving cross -lingual accessibility  - NLP , LLMs . 
• Enhanced text retrieval and translation accuracy  across Gujarati, English, Bengali, and Kannada by fine -tuning Bi-
Encoder, BM25, and ColBERT models  on MS MARCO and FIRE benchmarks, achieving robust performance on large -
scale retrieval tasks  - Finetuning LLMs . 
• Designed and implemented hierarchical embeddings  (clauses, sections,  summery ) and applied RAG techniques  to 
build a legal Q&A bot , enabling accurate semantic and referential query handling in complex legal documents  – RAG . 
Fitshield                                         Surat , India  
Jr. Data Scientist (Freelance)                   Sep, 2024  – Nov, 2024  
• Generated structured dish data using prompting techniques to identify ingredients and map accurate nutritional 
values – FastAPI, Prompt Engineering.  
• Retrieved appropriate nutritional values based on ingredient quantities, enhancing the accuracy of dietary 
information.  - Python  
• Implemented RAG with vector embeddings to enable semantic dish name search and efficient retrieval – FastAPI, 
RAG, VectorDB.  
Rootle.AI                            Ahmedabad , India  
Machine Learning Intern                  Dec, 2023  – June, 2024  
• Conducted in -depth EDA and visualization to improve user engagement by 3 -6% and performed Feature  
Engineering, Classification, and Clustering Model with Hyper -parameter Tuning on data. - Python, NumPy, Pandas, 
Seaborn, Plotly, scikit -learn, Machine Learning, Deep Learning . 
• Fine -tuned Gem ma3 with PEFT (LoRA), improving accuracy from 77% to 83%. Explored advanced Deep Learning, NLP , 
LangChain, and RAG concepts – NLP , Finetuning LLMs . 
  SAP - Code Unnati Program                               Vadodara , India  
  Data Science Trainee                                  Feb, 202 2 – Feb, 202 3 
• Completed training on Emerging Technologies (AI, I nternet of Things ) under the Code Unnati Program,  initiative by 
SAP , implemented by Edunet Foundation . It’s a Special hands -on learning program for train us to meet the upcoming 
INDUSTRY 4.0. Under this internship, I working in capstone project 'MOODMATE' using machine learning and deep 
learning  – AI, IOT, Python . 
 
 
 
PROJECTS  
Diamond Price Prediction  – GitHub             
• Built an end -to-end MLOps pipeline with MLflow for tracking, versioning, and lifecycle management. – MLflow . 
• Integrated trained regression model into a Flask app for real -time inference – Machine Learning, Regression Models . 
Intelligent News Article Extractor AI Agent  - GitHub                
• Built a Streamlit app with Gemini 1.5, LangChain for data scraping, metadata extraction, and classification - LangChain . 
• Integrated Airtable storage and automated Zapier alerts for trade -related content – Airtable, Zapier, Streamlit . 
Fire Safety Device  - GitHub                
• Developed a smart prototype that detects fire or gas leaks, automatically cuts electricity, and activates a fire 
extinguisher or water motor – Arduino  Microcontroller , IoT sensors.  
• Sends real -time alerts to the household and fire safety department via phone notifications – NodeMCU  
Microcontroller , Webhooks, IFTTT automation . 
EDUCATION  
Parul  University                                                                                GPA:  8.23   
Bachelor of Technology  in Computer Science &  Engineering                                                2020– 2024  
Kaushal Vidhya bhavan                                                                    Percentage: 76%  
12th Science  (Maths, Physics, Chemistry)                                                                                         2019– 2020 
SKILLS  
Technical : Python, SQL, MongoDB, Data Scraping, ETL, EDA, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Natural Language Processing 
(NLP), Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval -Augmented Generation (RAG), MLOps, Generative AI, AI Automation . 
NLP: Named Entity Recognition (NER), Word Embeddings, Bi -Encoder, ColBERT, LoRA, QLoRA, VectorDB, Prompt Engineering . 
Frameworks & Tools : FastAPI, Flask, MLflow, DVC, GitLab, PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, Docker, Git/GitHub, LangChain . 
ACHIEVEMENTS  
Deepfake  Audio  Detection  Challenge  – Fake Finders  Team: Secured 3rd place (Bronze) at S4P 2025 at Dhirubhai Ambani 
University, surpassing baseline F1 (0.64 to 0.67) by fine -tuning Whisper -large on DeepFox 2.0 multilingual dataset, deploying 
a scalable detection pipeline  – Whisper model, Py Torch , Teamwork . 
Cross lingual  Mathematical Information Retrieval  (CLMIR ) – Forum for Information Retrieval Evaluation  Conference 2025 
(IIT BHU, Varanasi):  As part of Team Retriever , secured 1st Rank  in Cross -Lingual Mathematical Information Retrieval 
(English –Hindi) , with evaluation  scores of nDCG: 0.3264, MAP: 0.2143, P@10: 0.128 , building a system for accurate retrieval 
of mathematical content across languages  – Retrieval  model s, RAG, L LMs. 
Multilingual Story -to-Image Generation – FIRE Conference 2025 (IIT BHU, Varanasi):  As Team Retriever , achieved 1st Rank  in 
both English  and Hindi  tracks for narrative -to-visual illustration, evaluated on Consistency, Relevance, and Visual Quality ; 
developed an AI pipeline for generating culturally relevant and coherent illustrations from multilingual stories  – Text to Image 
models, LLMs . 
CERTIFICATIONS  
· Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals   
· SAP Certified Application Associate - SAP Analytics Cloud   
· IoT and It’s Application Training - Parul university
